content.text: {"hazards":[{"type":"Fall from Height","description":"Multiple workers working at significant elevation on steel framework/scaffold without guardrails, fully planked platforms, or safety nets","severity":"high","osha_ref":"29 CFR 1926.501(b)(1)"},{"type":"Lack of Fall Protection","description":"Workers climbing and working at height without visible personal fall arrest systems with 100% tie-off","severity":"high","osha_ref":"29 CFR 1926.502(d)"},{"type":"Scaffold Safety Violation","description":"Incomplete scaffold structure in use as work platform without guardrails, proper planking, toeboards, and safe erection","severity":"high","osha_ref":"29 CFR 1926.451(b)(1), 1926.451(g)(4)"},{"type":"Unsafe Access","description":"Workers climbing structural members and diagonal bracing instead of using proper ladders or designated scaffold access","severity":"medium","osha_ref":"29 CFR 1926.451(e)(1)"},{"type":"Struck-By Falling Objects","description":"Workers positioned directly below other elevated workers creating exposure to falling tools and materials without overhead protection","severity":"medium","osha_ref":"29 CFR 1926.451(h)(1)"}]}
